reasoning_summary: Using the latest round-2 feedback as the primary signal, I centered this grid on the current best_params {bootstrap:false, max_depth:12, max_features:0.5, min_samples_leaf:2, min_samples_split:8, n_estimators:200}. Because status remains overfit (gap 0.159) but not severely so, I made only small local moves toward stronger regularization: slightly shallower depth, slightly larger split/leaf thresholds, and mostly kept bootstrap=false since all top candidates used it. I retained both max_features choices (0.5 and sqrt) because they were essentially tied in top candidates. With only 153 training samples and 2 features (76.5 samples/feature), a compact grid is appropriate and broad/high-capacity regions are unnecessary.
search_strategy: Local refinement around the round-2 best region with a mild regularization bias: keep the winning n_estimators and feature-subsetting neighborhood, drop clearly weaker broad branches, emphasize bootstrap=false, and probe nearby stronger-regularization settings via max_depth 10-12, min_samples_split 8-12, and min_samples_leaf 2-4 while keeping total combinations below the budget.
expected_effect_on_overfitting: Should modestly reduce overfitting by testing slightly shallower trees and larger split/leaf constraints while preserving the strongest-performing local region.
expected_effect_on_underfitting: Risk of mild underfitting increases slightly because the grid shifts toward more regularization, but the search still includes the current best setting to avoid over-correcting.
computational_cost_estimate: 72 combinations; low computational cost and safely under the 120-candidate limit.
warnings: Round-2 top candidates were nearly identical, suggesting a flat local response surface and potentially limited gains from further ExtraTrees tuning alone.
With only 2 features, max_features choices may have minimal practical differentiation.
If this grid still remains overfit with low CV R², model family or feature set changes may be more impactful than additional local hyperparameter refinement.
